answer: Put timing analysis of human vs bot submission patterns at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 479 pays 8622 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the mesa up to the light, weigh the falcon of the attack, and keep the lantern of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
